title.description: canonical headline shown in the panel — HTML, sanitized by the backend at write time

description.description: canonical body shown under the title — HTML, sanitized by the backend at write time

subject.description: email representation of the title; used as the title fallback

type.description: opaque category tag — used only for filtering, never for presentation

app.description: app that produced this notification — used to scope the panel to a single app

from_user_image.description: sender's photo for the default avatar. Resolved client-side today (see useNotifications); a candidate to become a server virtual field so the feed query carries it directly.

source_doctype.description: record the notification came from, when that is not the document itself (e.g. a Comment)

count.description: badge next to the label: the server unread count, or a count derived from fetched rows

items.description: A tab is a label + a filter. The filter is overloaded by type:   - object   → server-side filter merged into the feed query (affects counts + pagination)   - function → client-side predicate applied to already-fetched rows `value` is the stable key (used for the dynamic `#tab-<value>` slot); defaults to the label.

NotificationPanelProps.description: Panel props are *data* only — spread the controller's data members via `v-bind="controller"`. Actions are surfaced as **events** (`mark-as-read`, `mark-all-as-read`, `load-more`, `tab-change`), not function props; the active tab is two-way via `v-model:activeTab`.

header.description: Replaces the panel header (title, tabs, mark-all-read).

error.description: Shown in place of the list when loading fails.

empty.description: Shown when there are no notifications.
